highlight_bullets.head: 1.2M impressions delivered
highlight_bullets.detail: The campaign delivered 1,200,000 impressions across Washington, DC and Richmond, with 92% served on connected TV devices.

highlight_bullets.head: 950 unique visitors attributed
highlight_bullets.detail: The campaign drove 950 attributed unique visitors to the website, reflecting an attributed unique visitor rate of 0.079%.

highlight_bullets.head: Washington, DC leads performance
highlight_bullets.detail: Washington, DC received 800,000 impressions and achieved an attributed rate of 1.69%, the highest of the two markets.

highlight_bullets.head: Strong video completion rate
highlight_bullets.detail: Viewers completed ads at a 97% video completion rate, indicating highly engaged audiences across both markets.

takeaway_bullets.head: Campaign drove in-store intent
takeaway_bullets.detail: Store visit intent was the second-largest visitor intent category, with 210 attributed visits and a 22.11% share -- demonstrating real movement against the goal of driving in-store visits.

takeaway_bullets.head: Product consideration dominated post-click behavior
takeaway_bullets.detail: More than half of attributed visitors -- 480, representing a 50.53% share -- landed on product consideration pages, showing the campaign successfully moved audiences deeper into the purchase funnel.

takeaway_bullets.head: Home Improvement Intenders delivered results
takeaway_bullets.detail: The Home Improvement Intenders audience generated 19,560 attributed impressions at a 1.63% attributed rate, confirming the audience strategy was well-matched to campaign goals.

takeaway_bullets.head: Mid-flight optimization strengthened outcomes
takeaway_bullets.detail: Budget was reallocated away from lower-performing zip codes and days toward the strongest-performing market, improving overall campaign efficiency.

whats_next_bullets: Expand investment in Washington, DC, where the 1.69% attributed rate and top zip codes like 20852 (1.47x above baseline) show the strongest in-store visit signals.
Build on the 22.11% store visit intent share by adding location-specific messaging or store locator callouts to future creatives to further drive foot traffic.
Test additional budget against the Product Consideration segment -- with 480 visits and a 50.53% share -- to convert high-intent audiences into in-store customers and build brand awareness.
Explore extending the campaign into Richmond, where zip code 23225 outperformed the baseline rate by 1.17x, indicating an emerging opportunity in that market.

delivery_narrative: The campaign delivered 1,200,000 impressions to 41,000 unique viewers at an average frequency of 4.2, with 92% of impressions served on connected TV, led by Hulu at 300,000 impressions and Peacock at 200,000.
delivery_breakdown_narrative: Washington, DC received 800,000 impressions and Richmond received 400,000, reflecting the budget concentration in the top-performing market following mid-flight optimization.
goal_alignment_notes: The rep notes describe removing Wednesdays from the schedule mid-flight; no day-of-week performance data appears in the computed facts, so this optimization cannot be quantified or validated from the available data.
